message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) from the lexicon for the fact.

Fact: In 2011, defendant Zhu (朱某甲) applied to register a company (台州金香益生态农业开发有限公司). He lacked 500 million registration capital, so he hired Wang to provide the capital temporarily, paying 30,000 fee. He used fraud to deceive the registration authority, obtained business license, then withdrew 500 million to repay Wang. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

This is a fraud in company registration, i.e., "诈骗" (fraud) or "合同诈骗"? The lexicon includes "诈骗" (general fraud). Also "合同诈骗" (contract fraud) maybe not. The act is fraudulent misrepresentation to obtain business license, which is a type of fraud. Could also be "非法占用农用地"? No. "非法占用" not relevant. "挪用资金"? He used the 500 million to repay Wang, but he didn't misappropriate funds belonging to others; he used the capital to register the company, then withdrew it. Might be "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds) but the funds were not public or entrusted. He borrowed from Wang, then repaid. Not misappropriation.

"诈骗" is appropriate. Also maybe "非法行医"? No.

Thus charge: 诈骗.

Check lexicon: "诈骗". Yes.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
